purpose: Explicit, reversible review plan for known Armani canonical-identity collisions. This is a proposal only; it is not an executable migration.
approval_requirements: Verify product identity and concentration against authoritative manufacturer references.
Verify each affected size/variant against an authoritative source or GTIN/MPN.
Inventory all offer mappings and downstream references before moving or retiring any product_id.
Prepare a backup and rollback mapping before any catalog write.
Run the migration validator and end-to-end tests against a copy before review.

cases.diagnosis: Probable incomplete duplicate/legacy parent record, but SH-AUTO-0288 has no declared concentration or variants and must not be silently merged.
cases.proposed_action: Review SH-AUTO-0288 as a possible legacy alias/redirect to SH-AUTO-0018 only after confirming the official identity and finding every reference to SH-AUTO-0288. Preserve the old ID as a redirect/compatibility mapping if the repository supports it.
blocking_questions: Does every existing reference to SH-AUTO-0288 refer specifically to the EDT product?
Are there any non-EDT Acqua di Gio products or historical references represented by this record?

external_check.conclusion: The official catalog distinguishes Acqua di Giò EDT from other concentrations and Profondo. SH-AUTO-0018 is consistent with an EDT identity and declared 50/100/200 ml sizes; SH-AUTO-0288 remains an incomplete generic record. This does not establish that every reference to SH-AUTO-0288 is an EDT reference.

cases.diagnosis: Same normalized brand, canonical name and concentration split across two product IDs. Available records alone do not prove whether the sizes belong to one identity or whether a historical/release distinction is missing.
cases.proposed_action: Do not merge yet. Verify 75 ml and 125 ml with authoritative sources and verify all five variants independently. If they are the same product identity, nominate one canonical product ID, move variants without changing variant IDs, consolidate aliases without losing provenance, and preserve an old-ID redirect/reference map. Correct or validate the SH-0043 canonical image separately.
blocking_questions: Are the 75 ml and 125 ml EDP formats valid for the exact same Profondo release/market?
Which product ID is referenced by persisted offers, scraper mappings, analytics, or external clients?
Does the image currently attached to SH-0043 actually depict the canonical product and size?

external_check.conclusion: Current official sources list Profondo EDP 30/50/100/200 ml and a separate 150 ml refill; they do not list 75 ml or 125 ml on the pages checked. This is insufficient to delete or reassign those variants because older releases/markets remain possible. The SH-0043 image-size mismatch also remains unverified.

rollback_plan: Export and checksum the pre-migration product and variant records plus all references to affected product IDs.
Apply the approved mapping transactionally on a staging copy.
Validate unique product/variant IDs, variant ownership, GTIN/MPN uniqueness, reference integrity, and unchanged unaffected-record counts.
If any validation fails, restore the exact pre-migration snapshot and report the failure without publishing.

sources.name: Giorgio Armani Luxembourg official men's fragrance catalog
sources.finding: Official listing distinguishes Acqua di Giò EDT from Acqua di Giò Profondo EDP and lists Profondo EDP 50 ml and 100 ml; the same catalog lists Profondo Parfum separately and Profondo EDT separately.
sources.scope_limit: Current catalog evidence only; it does not prove that older or market-specific 75 ml and 125 ml EDP variants never existed.

sources.name: Armani Beauty official Profondo EDP product page
sources.finding: Official page lists Profondo Eau de Parfum formats 30 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml and 200 ml, plus a separate 150 ml refill.
sources.scope_limit: Current product page does not validate the catalog's 75 ml or 125 ml variants or the image attached to SH-0043.

sources.name: Armani Beauty official Acqua di Giò product catalog
sources.finding: Official catalog lists Acqua di Giò EDT in 50 ml and 100 ml and distinguishes EDT, EDP, Parfum and Profondo products.
sources.scope_limit: US catalog is corroborating product-family evidence, not definitive Luxembourg variant evidence.

external_verification.outcome: Current official evidence supports treating the Profondo 75 ml and 125 ml variants as unverified, not as confirmed invalid. Keep the migration blocked until variant-level evidence and downstream references are checked.

dependency_inventory.result: No persisted offer rows, GTINs, MPNs, or store_mappings are present for the four affected product identities/variants in the checked catalog snapshot.

code_reference_search.result: No direct literal references found in the core runtime files checked (backend/catalog_engine.py, backend/product_matcher.py, backend/main.py, and Next Engine repository/matcher/service files).
code_reference_search.caveat: This is not proof that runtime databases, logs, caches, external clients, or dynamically keyed mappings have no references. Full-repository exhaustive code search was not completed.

dependency_inventory.safety_conclusion: The checked catalog snapshot shows no in-catalog offer or retailer mapping dependencies, but that alone is not enough to authorize a merge. Runtime persistence and deployed data still need a read-only inventory before any catalog write.

deployed_runtime_check.finding: Deployment configuration identifies Fly.io app scenthunter with the persistent SQLite volume mounted at /data. The live database has NOT been inspected by this audit.
deployed_runtime_check.interpretation: No claim is made about whether the four product IDs or eight variant IDs are referenced in the production SQLite database. The required live reference inventory remains outstanding.
deployed_runtime_check.limitation: No approved direct Fly.io runtime/volume read interface was available through the connected GitHub actions. No deployment was triggered and no production data was changed.

next_gate.required_action: Obtain a read-only snapshot of /data/store_catalog.sqlite3 from the Fly.io persistent volume in an approved way, then run backend.scenthunter_next_engine.runtime_identity_reference_audit against that snapshot and review matching tables/columns before any migration.
next_gate.no_mutation_guarantee: The audit script opens the input database with SQLite mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON. It writes only the JSON report file.

runtime_audit_tool.execution: Run against a read-only copy/snapshot of the actual Fly.io persistent SQLite database. Do not deploy this branch merely to run the audit; production deployment remains on main.
